contract.uv: UV0 already carries the tiling: one UV unit is one repeat of the set (tile_size_m is the nominal size the UVs were laid out for; small blocks use up to 2x denser UVs). Sample BC, N, ORM and H at UV0; sample Macro at UV0 / 7. Do not rescale.
contract.textures: BC sRGB; N linear OpenGL (flip green on import); ORM linear (R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic = 0); H linear 16-bit height, used 0..1; Macro linear 512 px (R large, G medium, B small variation).
contract.vertex_colour: FBX vertex colour set 'Grime', linear RGBA float, exported with every LOD. R = dirt and damp, G = moss / algae, B = bleaching (silvered oak, lichen, dressed stone, fresh straw), A = material switch (see below; 1 everywhere else).
graph: base = BC * tint * (1 - macro + 2 * macro * Macro.R)
base = lerp(base, base * ORM.R, 0.5)
fd = saturate(R * (1.15 - 0.5 * H))
dirt_mode multiply: c = lerp(base, base * dirt, fd * dirt_amount);   dirt_mode mix: c = lerp(base, dirt * (3 * luminance(base) + 0.35), fd * dirt_amount)
fb = saturate(B * saturate(0.9 * H + 0.35));   c = lerp(c, pale * (2.2 * luminance(c) + 0.55), fb * pale_amount)
fm = saturate(4 * ((G + 0.5 * Macro.B) - (0.55 * H + 0.62))) * (G > 0.02);   c = lerp(c, moss * (0.9 * Macro.G + 0.55), fm)
roughness = lerp(ORM.G, moss_roughness, fm) - 0.10 * fd;   normal = N;   metallic = 0

alpha_switch materials only: A < 0.875 lead (only where alpha_lead is true): colour (0.15, 0.16, 0.17) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 0.65), roughness 0.42, flat normal;  A < 0.625 (A < 0.75 where alpha_lead is false) black iron, charred wood, burnt straw or unlit void: colour (0.016, 0.015, 0.014), roughness 0.5 + 0.42 * R (iron has R = 0, char has R = 1), normal kept;  A < 0.25 window glass: colour glass_tint, roughness 0.06, flat normal, opaque (the pane mesh is faceted so each quarry reflects differently; a dark closed box stands behind it). Values written: 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.
alpha_soot materials only: fs = saturate((1 - A) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 1.0));  c = lerp(c, (0.012, 0.011, 0.010), fs);  roughness = lerp(roughness, 0.97, fs)
contract.fbx: One FBX per asset beside the manifest: mesh objects <asset>_LOD0, _LOD1, _LOD2 (import as one static mesh with three LODs) and UCX_<asset>_LOD0_NN convex hulls; metres with UnitScaleFactor 100; Z up, front -Y; smoothing by edge (import normals); material slots in the order of each module's "materials" list. Family meshes are visual only (ART_STANDARD section 5).

modules.known_weaknesses: Thatch is now four slope planes with a rounded 0.4 m eaves roll, a 5 cm course ledge every 0.36 m, combed streaks, hollows, moss on the north pitch and ridge, hip rolls and a block ridge with three liggers a side; still faulted: the 0.54 m scan period shows close up; ledges are evenly spaced (real coats wander more); hip rolls are plain sweeps; no netting; the eaves butt is a smooth cut. Earth apron and flagstones are part of the mesh: its edge is a mesh edge against the terrain (vertex-colour green helps, it is not a blend). Door leaf is fixed ajar at 62 degrees (not a separate hinged object here; SM_Cottage_Door_PR is). The room behind the door is an unlit black face 0.3 m in. Jamb and quoin stones carry the rubble scan scaled, not single-stone textures. Rafter-pole feet are evenly spaced stubs. Bounds are not centred on the pivot any more (apron and flagstones reach 2.6 m in front): validator PIVOT by design, the pivot is still the centre of the 18 x 9 m walls. 77,000 triangles (soft target 60,000, hard 200,000).

contract.uv: UV0 already carries the tiling: one UV unit is one repeat of the set (tile_size_m is the nominal size the UVs were laid out for; small blocks use up to 2x denser UVs). Sample BC, N, ORM and H at UV0; sample Macro at UV0 / 7. Do not rescale.
contract.textures: BC sRGB; N linear OpenGL (flip green on import); ORM linear (R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic = 0); H linear 16-bit height, used 0..1; Macro linear 512 px (R large, G medium, B small variation).
contract.vertex_colour: FBX vertex colour set 'Grime', linear RGBA float, exported with every LOD. R = dirt and damp, G = moss / algae, B = bleaching (silvered oak, lichen, dressed stone, fresh straw), A = material switch (see below; 1 everywhere else).
graph: base = BC * tint * (1 - macro + 2 * macro * Macro.R)
base = lerp(base, base * ORM.R, 0.5)
fd = saturate(R * (1.15 - 0.5 * H))
dirt_mode multiply: c = lerp(base, base * dirt, fd * dirt_amount);   dirt_mode mix: c = lerp(base, dirt * (3 * luminance(base) + 0.35), fd * dirt_amount)
fb = saturate(B * saturate(0.9 * H + 0.35));   c = lerp(c, pale * (2.2 * luminance(c) + 0.55), fb * pale_amount)
fm = saturate(4 * ((G + 0.5 * Macro.B) - (0.55 * H + 0.62))) * (G > 0.02);   c = lerp(c, moss * (0.9 * Macro.G + 0.55), fm)
roughness = lerp(ORM.G, moss_roughness, fm) - 0.10 * fd;   normal = N;   metallic = 0

alpha_switch materials only: A < 0.875 lead (only where alpha_lead is true): colour (0.15, 0.16, 0.17) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 0.65), roughness 0.42, flat normal;  A < 0.625 (A < 0.75 where alpha_lead is false) black iron, charred wood, burnt straw or unlit void: colour (0.016, 0.015, 0.014), roughness 0.5 + 0.42 * R (iron has R = 0, char has R = 1), normal kept;  A < 0.25 window glass: colour glass_tint, roughness 0.06, flat normal, opaque (the pane mesh is faceted so each quarry reflects differently; a dark closed box stands behind it). Values written: 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.
alpha_soot materials only: fs = saturate((1 - A) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 1.0));  c = lerp(c, (0.012, 0.011, 0.010), fs);  roughness = lerp(roughness, 0.97, fs)
contract.fbx: One FBX per asset beside the manifest: mesh objects <asset>_LOD0, _LOD1, _LOD2 (import as one static mesh with three LODs) and UCX_<asset>_LOD0_NN convex hulls; metres with UnitScaleFactor 100; Z up, front -Y; smoothing by edge (import normals); material slots in the order of each module's "materials" list. Family meshes are visual only (ART_STANDARD section 5).

contract.uv: UV0 already carries the tiling: one UV unit is one repeat of the set (tile_size_m is the nominal size the UVs were laid out for; small blocks use up to 2x denser UVs). Sample BC, N, ORM and H at UV0; sample Macro at UV0 / 7. Do not rescale.
contract.textures: BC sRGB; N linear OpenGL (flip green on import); ORM linear (R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic = 0); H linear 16-bit height, used 0..1; Macro linear 512 px (R large, G medium, B small variation).
contract.vertex_colour: FBX vertex colour set 'Grime', linear RGBA float, exported with every LOD. R = dirt and damp, G = moss / algae, B = bleaching (silvered oak, lichen, dressed stone, fresh straw), A = material switch (see below; 1 everywhere else).
graph: base = BC * tint * (1 - macro + 2 * macro * Macro.R)
base = lerp(base, base * ORM.R, 0.5)
fd = saturate(R * (1.15 - 0.5 * H))
dirt_mode multiply: c = lerp(base, base * dirt, fd * dirt_amount);   dirt_mode mix: c = lerp(base, dirt * (3 * luminance(base) + 0.35), fd * dirt_amount)
fb = saturate(B * saturate(0.9 * H + 0.35));   c = lerp(c, pale * (2.2 * luminance(c) + 0.55), fb * pale_amount)
fm = saturate(4 * ((G + 0.5 * Macro.B) - (0.55 * H + 0.62))) * (G > 0.02);   c = lerp(c, moss * (0.9 * Macro.G + 0.55), fm)
roughness = lerp(ORM.G, moss_roughness, fm) - 0.10 * fd;   normal = N;   metallic = 0

alpha_switch materials only: A < 0.875 lead (only where alpha_lead is true): colour (0.15, 0.16, 0.17) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 0.65), roughness 0.42, flat normal;  A < 0.625 (A < 0.75 where alpha_lead is false) black iron, charred wood, burnt straw or unlit void: colour (0.016, 0.015, 0.014), roughness 0.5 + 0.42 * R (iron has R = 0, char has R = 1), normal kept;  A < 0.25 window glass: colour glass_tint, roughness 0.06, flat normal, opaque (the pane mesh is faceted so each quarry reflects differently; a dark closed box stands behind it). Values written: 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.
alpha_soot materials only: fs = saturate((1 - A) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 1.0));  c = lerp(c, (0.012, 0.011, 0.010), fs);  roughness = lerp(roughness, 0.97, fs)
contract.fbx: One FBX per asset beside the manifest: mesh objects <asset>_LOD0, _LOD1, _LOD2 (import as one static mesh with three LODs) and UCX_<asset>_LOD0_NN convex hulls; metres with UnitScaleFactor 100; Z up, front -Y; smoothing by edge (import normals); material slots in the order of each module's "materials" list. Family meshes are visual only (ART_STANDARD section 5).
